source: Data supplied by Donald P. Green

selection.rule: Rank full-sample GOTV contacted-voter counts and include all ties at the cutoff. Selection uses no turnout outcomes, treatment-effect estimates, or benchmark errors.

target: Complier average effect of GOTV contact on August 2008 primary turnout within each target.
calibration: Observational minus full-sample Wald contrasts in the other 52 retained individual districts. Household-clustered variances account for covariance and the estimated contact rate.
evaluation: One fixed household split within district and assignment arm: 10% experimental, 45% observational, and 45% held-out experimental benchmark. Selection is held fixed.
